status: TESTED ON HARDWARE - BOOTLOADER UNLOCK CONFIRMED

patch.effect: Skips the Sn Image authorization guard in the fastboot oem unlock handler. The handler retains the volume-key confirmation, lock-state check, and set_lock_state(0) path.

build.method: Val Protocol LK repack with legacy CERT2 hash override
build.container_check: Only the lk payload and cert2 component differ; all other components are byte-identical to the official image. Only 4 payload bytes changed.

hardware_result.unlock_confirmation: Tap Volume Up/Down during the ~5 second window; holding a key did not register
hardware_result.unlock_result: Start unlock flow; unlock success; OKAY

limitations: Validated on one XT2575-4 unit only; not a universal exploit.
Only slot a was flashed; lk_b was not written and was not tested as a fallback.
The installed Android build remained 17.5.10.017; the LK is from 17.5.10.020.
SP Flash Tool recovery is the intended fallback but was not exercised on this unit.
Do not relock, do not flash both slots, and do not run full stock flashing scripts as cleanup without a tested recovery path.
